newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: Indonesia's rupiah was little changed against the dollar in slow late trading on Thursday, with tom/next swaps rising ahead of an expected liquidity tightening on Friday, dealers said.
"The tom/next swap rate was higher in active trading as operators expect liquidity to tighten on Friday due to likely large tax payments," one Japanese bank dealer said.
The dealer, however, said the spot rate barely moved and was trapped in a narrow range.
"The chances of an upward movement in the local currency, however, have been restricted by earlier expectations of a higher central bank fixing in the afternoon," another dealer said.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention band by one point to 2,351/2,543 and the conversion band to 2,351/2,399 late on Thursday.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2,352.75/53.20 against an opening of 2,352.50/53.25.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were last quoted at 2,351.00/51.30 and 2,350.50/50.90, respectively.
Overnight swap was at 0.35/0.45 from an opening of 0.45/0.55 while tom/next was last at 1.70/1.80 against an opening of 1.60/1.70.
One-month swap was at 15.00/15.75, two at 30.50/31.50, three at 43.00/43.75 and 12 months at 170.00/175.00 points.
